_orgwave.title: GitHub
_orgwave.purpose: List/filter org repos and GitHub metadata during OrgWave discovery.
env: No `env` block in this file: avoid empty GITHUB_TOKEN from Cursor expanding `${env:...}` into the MCP child. Tokens come from repo `.env` (envFile), launcher merge order, and `gh`.

~/.zshrc: `github-mcp-launch.mjs` sources it non-interactively and fills GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN / GITHUB_TOKEN / GH_TOKEN only when those keys are still empty (typical Dock or Run-in-Cursor launches).
GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN in repo-root `.env` (envFile) wins when set.
Then (unless ORGWAVE_MCP_PREFER_ENV_TOKEN=1): `gh auth token` (launcher prepends Homebrew PATH, stdin ignored so MCP stdio stays clean), then GITHUB_TOKEN / GH_TOKEN from the process.
~/.cursor/github-mcp.env or ~/.config/orgwave/github-mcp.env merges into empty keys only.
Optional: `cd orgwave/mcp-runtime && npm ci` once for fast MCP startup (avoids slow npx cold install).
